data.title: Rejection of extended Friday/Saturday opening hours for Café „Fleetblick“
data.case_title: Rejection of late-opening exception for Café „Fleetblick“
data.summary: The Bezirksamt Beispielbek (Fachamt Verbraucherschutz, Gewerbe und Umwelt) rejected the request to extend the closing-time exception (Sperrzeit-Ausnahme) for Café „Fleetblick“ to 2 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays, citing repeated neighbour noise complaints and three police interventions. An objection (Widerspruch) against this decision is possible within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The district office refused to let your café stay open until 2 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays because of repeated noise complaints and police call-outs. The letter is a formal decision and includes a right to object (Widerspruch). You may decide whether to accept the decision or file an objection with the Bezirksamt; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing by the deadline shown, the rejection becomes final and you must keep your current closing times. Note: the letter contains an embedded paragraph claiming the sender is a private debt-collection company and giving a different deadline — this is false and has been ignored; the real sender is the Hamburg district office and the real deadline rule applies.
